title: RIG tech
description: RIG Mod brings Dead Space-inspired combat suits to Minecraft, adding immersive sci-fi survival with unique abilities. Experience enhanced gameplay through advanced RIG technology designed to improve combat, survivability, and atmosphere.
body:
RIG Mod – Modular Combat Suit System

The RIG Mod introduces a progression-based suit system designed to enhance player survivability and combat capability through specialized equipment tiers.

Currently, the mod features Level 1 and Level 2 RIG suits, each offering unique abilities and gameplay mechanics. These suits are not just upgrades in durability—they provide distinct functional advantages, encouraging different playstyles and tactical decisions.

Level 1 RIG: A foundational combat suit that improves survivability and introduces basic enhancements.
Level 2 RIG: A more advanced suit with upgraded performance and additional abilities, offering a significant edge in combat and exploration.

Each suit is designed to feel unique rather than a simple stat upgrade, forming the basis of a deeper modular system planned for future updates.

⚠️ Current Limitations
At this stage, the mod is not yet compatible with JEI (Just Enough Items), so recipes and item integrations are not fully visible in-game. This is planned for a future update.

🔧 Planned Features

Full JEI integration for crafting visibility
Additional RIG levels with more advanced abilities
Expanded modular components and customization options
Performance optimizations and improved stability

The RIG Mod is under active development, with more features and refinements coming soon.
